methodology.speaker_measure: sum of one CLDR-derived fluent-speaker estimate per distinct sampled Glottolog language; L1/L2 may overlap
methodology.deduplication: multiple GlottoDelta source records mapped to one distinct Glottolog language contribute at most one estimate
methodology.purpose: analysis order only; larger speaker-exposure estimates are examined first
methodology.not_a_weight: the eventual genealogical F score must not inherit these population magnitudes as family weights
methodology.missing_data_rule: represented units with no CLDR-derived estimate are explicitly unranked rather than assigned invented values
